product_metadata.title: Chef Craft Select Plastic Measuring Cup, 2 Cup, Clear
features: Clear plastic for durability and ease of measuring
Both US and metric graduations to suit any recipe
Can be used to measure liquids or powders
description: Chef Craft's Measuring Cups are made of durable plastic to prevent breaking when dropped and contain measurements in both metric and US units. The measuring cups are family friendly, perfect to teach the little ones in your house how to measure and cook! They are great for both liquids and solids and are easy to pour. Dishwasher safe for an easy and efficient clean up.
